values.binNote: BonusDamageCalc = BaseDamageCalc * SweetSpotDamageMod(1.5), i.e. (40..120 + 0.5xbonusAD)*1.5 = 60..180 + 0.75xbonusAD, matching the wiki's separate leveling row.

values.quote: ''Aureate Rush'' deals {{as|50 '''bonus''' physical damage}} against monsters.

mechanics.claim: Damage is dealt on arrival at the dash's destination, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: Upon arrival, he flourishes his glaive to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.

mechanics.claim: If the dash is interrupted, the flourish damage fails to occur.
mechanics.quote: If the dash is interrupted, '''Zaahen''' will fail to deal damage.

mechanics.claim: The physical and magic damage components are two separate instances, physical applied first in the same tick; if the physical damage kills, the magic damage does not apply.
mechanics.quote:
The mixed damage is applied in two instances, and the {{as|physical damage}} will be dealt first within the same game tick.
** If the {{as|physical damage}} finishes off the unit, the {{as|magic damage}} will not be dealt against it.

mechanics.claim: The outer-edge magic damage against monsters is capped at 400.
mechanics.quote: with the latter capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}.
